scope: Selected verified primary literature; not an exhaustive latest-publication census. Raw web captures remain in ignored .firecrawl, not redistributed as full papers.

sources.title: Large deviations for Markov jump processes with mean-field interaction via the comparison principle for an associated Hamilton-Jacobi equation
sources.read_scope: abstract, introduction, Theorem2.3 and Hamiltonian/Lagrangian conditions
sources.result: Trajectory LDP for a broad finite-state interacting-jump class, with a Hamilton-Jacobi comparison principle.
sources.conditions: Convergent jump intensities, positivity/regularity at boundary and initial-law LDP; check the exact theorem assumptions.
sources.FIN_role: Primary method for actual LOO interacting path action; not a physical action or automatic visible-only contraction.

sources.title: On the Relation between Gradient Flows and the Large-Deviation Principle, with Applications to Markov Chains and Diffusion
sources.read_scope: publisher abstract and preprint metadata/abstract; full theorem application remains a task
sources.result: Conditions linking rate-function Lagrangians to generalized gradient structures.
sources.conditions: Specific structural symmetry of the rate cost; illustrated independent-particle constructions are not the interacting FIN model.
sources.FIN_role: Distinguish derived nonlinear dissipation/noise from merely matching a deterministic gradient. ST8548 already used related independent-walker theory.

sources.title: Glauber Dynamics for the mean-field Potts Model
sources.result: Spinodal mixing crossover and critical window for mean-field Potts Glauber dynamics.
sources.conditions: Potts matrix/model, discrete single-update clock; FIN rank7 is not that matrix.
sources.FIN_role: Benchmark for N^(-2/3) window and critical stochastic scaling. Convert N updates per unit FIN time; do not inherit their global mixing theorem.

sources.title: Uniform-in-Time Convergence Rates to a Nonlinear Markov Chain for Mean-Field Interacting Jump Processes
sources.result: Uniform-in-time weak O(1/N) convergence under unique exponentially stable mean-field equilibrium.
sources.conditions: Uniqueness and exponential stability of the nonlinear stationary law, not just one global energy minimizer.
sources.FIN_role: Recent benchmark for stable regimes. Not directly licensed at coexistence, multistability or the fold; motivates stopped/local error analysis.

sources.title: Arbitrarily accurate, nonparametric coarse graining with Markov renewal processes and the Mori-Zwanzig formulation
sources.read_scope: abstract and introduction; canonical arXiv dates used rather than a rendered TeX date
sources.result: Memory-aware coarse records via Markov renewal and nonparametric Mori-Zwanzig construction.
sources.conditions: Specified microscopic dynamics, observation and appropriate renewal/memory representation.
sources.FIN_role: Alternative representation benchmark when exact lumpability fails; not a new fundamental memory law or evidence of FIN uniqueness.

sources.title: Gradient flows of the entropy for finite Markov chains
sources.read_scope: primary abstract and reversible finite-chain domain
sources.result: Entropy-gradient representation with a discrete transport metric.
sources.conditions: Given irreducible reversible Markov kernel; the metric is on probability laws.
sources.FIN_role: Already related to ST8547; not a source of rates, physical space, dimensions or fundamental entropy selection.

sources.title: Finite Exchangeable Sequences
sources.result: Quantitative finite-marginal approximation by mixtures of iid laws.
sources.conditions: Exchangeable finite sequences; finite marginal size/population distinction matters.
sources.FIN_role: Phase-mixture/conditional-chaos and projective-consistency questions. Finite Gibbs families do not become projectively consistent merely by exchangeability.

sources.title: Solutions of ordinary differential equations as limits of pure jump Markov processes
sources.conditions: Appropriate generator convergence/regularity and initial conditions.
sources.FIN_role: Background for the already admitted mean-field law, not a duplicate primary campaign. Original issue is1970, despite later online posting.

sources.title: Critical dynamics and fluctuations for a mean-field model of cooperative behavior
sources.result: Non-Gaussian critical fluctuations on slower time scales in an interacting oscillator mean-field model.
sources.conditions: Anharmonic oscillator/diffusion model, not finite-label LOO heat bath.
sources.FIN_role: Critical-fluctuation methodology benchmark, not transferred coefficients/exponents.

sources.title: Solutions of a Stochastic Differential Equation Forced Onto a Manifold by a Large Drift
sources.result: Semimartingale limits with strong stable-manifold attraction.
sources.conditions: Well-behaved driving semimartingales, stable manifold, tightness and coordinate assumptions.
sources.FIN_role: Possible fast-mode elimination tool after proving the rescaled FIN generator meets its hypotheses; no automatic center-manifold SDE theorem.

sources.title: Nonequilibrium Markov processes conditioned on large deviations
sources.read_scope: primary abstract, assumptions and publication metadata
sources.result: Driven/conditioned processes through generalized Doob transforms and path-ensemble equivalence.
sources.conditions: Specified rare-event observable and convex rate-function regime.
sources.FIN_role: Analyse conditional trajectories without renaming conditioning as native fundamental dynamics. A driven process does not source a physical drive.

sources.title: From classical to quantum dynamics at Rokhsar-Kivelson points
sources.result: Constructed correspondence between detailed-balance stochastic models and quantum Hamiltonians.
sources.conditions: Representation/Hamiltonian construction and imaginary-time relation; physical interpretation is extra.
sources.FIN_role: Benchmark explaining why a self-adjoint stochastic operator is not by itself a derivation of QM. Parked, not an active quantum campaign.

sources.title: Proximité et dualité dans un espace hilbertien
sources.read_scope: primary bibliographic record and proximal-context identification; not full proof replay
sources.conditions: Convex/functional analytic hypotheses matter; unspecified nonconvex GEN costs do not automatically meet them.
sources.FIN_role: Context for existing argmin updates. The freezing/separability results here have direct elementary proofs and do not assume Moreau selects a physical law.

sources.title: Proof of the Diaconis--Freedman Conjecture on partially-exchangeable processes
sources.read_scope: primary abstract and exact transience/partial-exchangeability scope
sources.result: Transition-count structure for transient partially exchangeable processes on countable sets.
sources.conditions: Partial exchangeability and transience are different from copy-permutation symmetry; finite irreducible FIN is recurrent.
sources.FIN_role: Recent boundary benchmark for record/history sufficiency. No direct theorem transfer to finite FIN or its hidden observed process.

sources.title: Large deviations of mean-field interacting particle systems in a fast varying environment
sources.result: LDP for coupled finite-state mean-field systems with a fast environment.
sources.conditions: An explicit environment/time-scale model is supplied.
sources.FIN_role: Methodological comparison only unless the fast variables/time separation are derived from the existing FIN generator. Do not add an environment/clock to use the theorem.
